findings.description: wrapFileContent() sentinel not escaped — prompt injection via </file-content> in wrapped content.
cwd validation accepts UNC/device paths on Windows despite fail-closed intent.
Hook command POSIX quoting invalid on Windows shells — injection via path metacharacters.
Narrowed catch rejects valid SQLite FTS shadow table and rename-conflict error messages.
maxResponseBytes relies on content-length header only — chunked/compressed responses bypass.
Grep gate requires output.content but grep payloads use matchCount/matches fields.
computeAvgRecent returns 1.0 on empty history — always fails shift gate threshold.
Checkpoint tracking updated even when writeCheckpoint fails (returns null).
Array sanitization doesn't filter non-string elements or cap array length.
Decision dedup window of 100 allows old duplicates to re-insert.
Bridge adapter persists raw error strings unlike sanitized CC hooks path.
updateTopic() method added but has no callers — topic shifts never persisted.
Error matching depends on brittle err.message.includes() — fragile across SQLite versions.
Adapter-column migration logic duplicated between migrateFromV2 and migrateV1toV2.
Dual version tracking (PRAGMA user_version vs schema_versions table) without explicit mapping.
Decision fingerprint generated from unredacted text — sensitive tokens recoverable.
Reclaim loop breaks after first candidate regardless of re-validation success.
key_exchanges filter throws on null entry or non-string role.
Trailing-separator stripping collapses root paths to empty string.
posInt validator accepts fractional values — downstream expects integers.
Functions changed from async to sync but callers still await them.
